facts.business: The company manufactures gears, gear boxes and other transmission components.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act and details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards. Certain repetitive transactions were approved through omnibus route by Audit Committee and Board. Material transactions exceeding limits under section 188 were done with prior approval of Members. Regulation 23 of SEBI LODR is not applicable.
